title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in LeapWorx Premium…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in LeapWorx Premium Addons for Elementor up to version 4.11.116. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
